summary:
A 24-year-old gunman killed six people and injured 15, by one count, or 16, by another, in a shooting in Kraków's market square, Poland. Among the dead was a British man. He died in hospital after a shootout with police, and three bodies of his family members were found at their home. Polish authorities have opened a terrorism investigation, and the justice minister said it will examine whether he acted alone.

Nvidia's board said on Sunday that it is initiating an independent investigation after reports that CEO Jensen Huang was targeted by a foreign intelligence operation. The New York Times reported he had an affair with an executive US intelligence believed was gathering information for Beijing, which denied the claim. Huang has apologized and will remain CEO, and the company's shares fell more than 4%.

Trump told CNN on Sunday that new strikes on Iran were 'highly unlikely' while nuclear talks and the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz progressed. Oil slid more than 3%, and Iran has put forward a proposal developed with Qatari mediators that Washington is examining. Qatar's prime minister is to meet Trump.

headlines.title: Gunman kills six in Kraków market square shooting
headlines.summary: A 24-year-old gunman killed six people and injured 15 by one count or 16 by another in Kraków's market square. He died in hospital after a shootout with police, and three bodies of his family members were found at their home.

headlines.title: Nvidia investigates reports CEO Jensen Huang was targeted by intelligence
headlines.summary: Nvidia's board said on Sunday it would investigate reports that CEO Jensen Huang was targeted by a foreign intelligence operation. The New York Times reported he had an affair with an executive US intelligence believed was gathering information for Beijing.

headlines.title: Trump says further Iran strikes unlikely if talks progress

headlines.title: Ukraine peace talks resume this week in Abu Dhabi
headlines.summary: US-led talks to end the war between Russia and Ukraine resume this week in Abu Dhabi, and a ceasefire will not be on the table. European leaders fear Ukraine could be pressed to accept a bad deal, and G7 ministers are meeting on the issue.

headlines.title: Eisenkot given six weeks to form Israeli government
headlines.summary: President Isaac Herzog gave opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot the first chance to form a government on Sunday, with six weeks to assemble a coalition to oust Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. Eisenkot, a former military chief, has begun reaching out to Netanyahu's allies.

headlines.title: ANC records worst-ever result in South Africa municipal election
headlines.summary: The African National Congress slumped to its worst-ever result in South Africa's municipal election, with voters blaming the party for water and electricity shortages. President Cyril Ramaphosa said the verdict must be respected, and the party's secretary-general called the outcome 'catastrophic'.

headlines.title: At least 34 dead after migrant boat sinks off Senegal
headlines.summary: At least 34 people died when a migrant boat bound for Spain's Canary Islands sank near Kebemer off northwestern Senegal. Authorities on El Hierro declared an emergency after a marked increase in migrant boat arrivals.

headlines.title: Train collision south of Cairo kills several and injures over 100
headlines.summary: Two trains travelling in the same direction collided and derailed south of Cairo, with authorities confirming several deaths and more than 100 injured. One report gave the death toll as seven, and more than 50 ambulances were deployed to the scene.
